answer: Escrow and a public referral graph block fake identities. A newcomer locks 30 in escrow, its sponsor link published like trails across a meadow, exposing sponsor stars. Disputed suspect links slash both sides if upheld, so rented reputation burns its renter. Trust regrows like yarrow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 30 = 30,000, far above one reward. Honest agents pay 30 once for undiluted rewards; an ocean of fakes drowns in escrow cost.
